notes.title: The Electric Pack DLC for Project CARS 3 is available now !
notes.content:
The "[b]Electric Pack[/b]" shines a light on the [b]vehicles of the future[/b] with four astonishing electric-powered sports and race cars: [b]2020 Porsche Taycan Turbo S[/b], [b]2020 Volkswagen ID.R[/b], [b]2019 Nio EP9[/b], and, [b]for the first time in a racing sim[/b],  [b]2020 Audi AI:RACE[/b].

The “[b]Electric Pack[/b]” also features a [b]new free track for all players[/b], the [b]beloved Dutch racetrack at Zandvoort[/b], complete with [b]3 unique layouts[/b].
[previewyoutube=YsgekrKqA9E;full][/previewyoutube]
The “Electric Pack” cars:
[list]
[*] The [b]2020 Porsche Taycan Turbo S[/b] is “soul, electrified”. 750hp,  0-100kmh in 2.5s, and a brain-warping 1.3Gs under full acceleration. 
[*] The [b]2020 Volkswagen ID.R[/b] is the first car to break the 8-minute barrier at Pikes Peak and lapped the Nürburgring in a jaw-dropping 6:05.336—the fastest electric vehicle in the world. 
[*] The [b]2020 Audi AI:RACE[/b] is Audi’s design and technical all-electric concept car with 765hp in boost mode and 0-100kmh in a blink over 2s. LMP1-like performance.
[*] The [b]2019 Nio EP9[/b] holds world records for production cars on many tracks around the world and tops out at a blistering  350kmh. 
[/list]
The “Electric Pack” also includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Latest “Season 7” Formula E liveries [/b]
[*] [b]16 themed career events[/b]
[*] [b]New “Electric Pack-based” achievements and trophies[/b]
[*] [b]12 Liveries / 20 Decals / 5 Patterns[/b]
[*] [b]5 Rims / 10 Tyres[/b]
[*] [b]10 License Plates / 5 Race Numbers[/b]
[*] [b]1 new character with 10 outfits and 10 helmets[/b]
[/list]

The “[b]Electric Pack[/b]” is the final additional content for Project CARS 3. The “[b]Power Pack[/b]”, “[b]Legends Pack[/b]”, and “[b]Style Pack[/b]” are already available, each featuring [b]one free track available for all Project CARS 3 players[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354053/Project_CARS_3_Electric_Pack/

notes.title: The Power Pack DLC for Project CARS 3 is available now !
notes.content:
The [b]“Power Pack”[/b] brings three legendary Japanese icons to the racing game: The [b]1985 Toyota Sprinter Trueno GT-Apex (AE86)[/b], the [b]Nissan Silvia S15 Spec-R Aero[/b], and the [b]Nissan 370Z[/b]. In addition, the [b]2021 Nissan Z Proto[/b] will make its much-anticipated first appearance in a video game. All four cars also come with their unique Race Conversion kits.

The “Power Pack” also brings a [b]new free track for all players[/b], the [b]Lake Valley Speedway[/b], located in Utah, USA, with [b]4 unique layouts[/b].

The “Power Pack” cars:
[list]
  [*][b]1985 Toyota Sprinter Trueno GTApex (AE86)[/b] + Race Conversion Kit 
  [*][b]2002 Nissan Silvia S15 SpecR Aero[/b] + Race Conversion Kit 
  [*][b]2020 Nissan 370Z[/b] + Race Conversion Kit 
  [*][b]2021 Nissan Z Proto[/b] + Race Conversion Kit 
[/list]
The “Power Pack” also includes:
[list]
  [*][b]16 themed events[/b]
  [*][b]New "Legends Pack-based" achievements and trophies[/b]
  [*][b]12 Liveries / 20 Decals / 5 Patterns[/b]
  [*][b]5 Rims / 10 Tyres[/b]
  [*][b]10 License Plates / 5 Race Numbers[/b]
  [*][b]1 new character with 10 outfits and 10 helmets[/b]
[/list]
The [b]“Power Pack”[/b] is the third of four content packs coming to Project CARS 3. The [b]“Legends Pack”[/b] and the [b]“Style Pack”[/b] are already available, and the final pack, [b]“Electric Pack”[/b], will be released in Spring 2021, adding [b]new cars and unique customization items[/b]. Each pack also features [b]one free track available for all Project CARS 3 players[/b].

[previewyoutube=4d53-WuCkps;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354110/Project_CARS_3_SEASON_PASS/

[url=https://en.bandainamcoent.eu/project-cars/news/the-third-project-cars-3-dlc-the-power-pack-out-now][b]Read the patch notes here[/b][/url].

notes.title: Project CARS 3 Update 3
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Project CARS 3! We hope this latest update will improve your playing experience.

[h2]Online[/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue with online players moving at different times during rolling starts fixed with automatic race delay countdown 
[*] New lobby browse flow
[*] New post-race flow in MP
[*] Fixed host assist settings for all MP participants
[*] Fixed an issue that caused MP options to become inactive after reconnecting ethernet cable
[/list]

[h2]GUI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix for Photo Mode vignette effect 
[*] Fix for pressing the “Hide HUD” button during the post-race spectating sequence 
[*] Fix for when you hit “0 attempts left” in Rivals Mode and the Race button wasn’t greyed-out
[*] Fixed button to toggle between loaner and owned cars being labelled as "0" in vehicle select
[*] Fix for decals being replaced while applying decals in certain slots and scrolling through decal placement options 
[*] Fix for highlighting the GT Open tab causing the Road E class picture to appear
[*] Disabled the “Resume” button when Photo button pressed
[*] Changed sort order of proximity arrows
[*] Added number of attempts left in Rivals to pre-race menu and pause menu
[*] Fixed the track loading screen background flashing at the beginning of the “Welcome to” screen
[*] Improved framerate during video playback
[*] Fixed a crash exiting replays
[*] Updated to the latest Nissan logo
[*] Missing skip tutorial label in Brazilian Portuguese and Neutral Spanish added
[/list]

[h2]Career[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix for cars not unlocking when user levelled up without leaving post-race screen, interrupting Career progression (this fix retroactively corrects any profiles which were affected by this issue).
[/list]

[h2]Physics[/h2]
[list]
[*] TrueForce initial implementation. Implementation uses haptic thread to provide high-frequency procedural waves for the rumble effects
[*] Modulated TruForce slip rumble based on surface wetness
[*] Fine tuned slide threshold for TrueForce
[*] Fixed TrueForce curb rumble at speed  
[*] Fixed rolling start discrepancy when TC is enabled. 
[/list]

[h2]Characters[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed female character 1 
[/list]

[h2]Environments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Willow Springs Horse Thief Mile: Removed “rallycross” tag that was making cars pick the dirt tyre option in all-weather conditions
[*] Mojave: Fixed various holes in the terrain 
[*] Fuji: Sponsor updates for the track
[*] Azure Coast Full: Fixed the AI turning abruptly after the finish line in the post-race screen
[*] Knockhill National: Adjusted corridors further out onto the track surface 
[*] Knockhill National: Fixed the AI contacting the edge of the barrier when attempting to squeeze past slow or stopped cars
[*] Sakitto National: Slowed AI lap times 2-3 seconds at Legendary
[*] Zolder: Fixed a flickering glass window issue
[*] Monument Canyon B: Fixed the 32nd grid spot being slightly in front of the 31st
[*] Yas Marina: Fixed various LOD popping on track 
[*] Zhuhai: Fixed some tree rendering on the track
[*] Hockenheimring GP Classic: Fixed some trees popping
[*] Added Bahrain to the track list
[/list]

[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when user applied a racing conversion kit to the last car in their garage 
[*] 2015 Ford Mustang GT Racing: Made interior dark grey instead of white 
[*] Honda Civic Racing: Made interior dark grey instead of white 
[*] Mercedes A45 TCR: Made interior dark grey instead of white 
[*] Caterham 620R + Racing: Tyre update to stop colour popping when selecting factory livery 
[*] BMW M6 GT3: Tyre fix to stop logo popping at distance
[*] Removed exceptions for McLaren P1 GTR, now all custom rims can be chosen
[*] Honda 2&4: Fixed missing animation for accelerating and braking
[*] Audi R8 LMP900: Edited front suspension to avoid clipping with bonnet
[/list]

notes.title: Project CARS 3 Update 2
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Project CARS 3! We hope this latest update will improve your playing experience.

[h2]Online[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crash during shut down when the game browser is refreshing resolved
[*] Online Reputation: Improvements and various fixes
[*] Inability to lose Online Reputation from the Profile resolved
[*] Fixed crash when simultaneously pressing “Delete” and “Back” keys on a saved Style before selecting “Yes” to the dialogue box
[*] Steam MP breaking when minimising window during load-to-race fixed
[/list]

[h2]Rendering[/h2]
[list]
[*] The replay of the player’s vehicle continuously in ghost form after the user re-spawns and appears in ghost form to view a replay, resolved 
[*] Water-spray headlight, opacity, and colour tweaked
[*] Fixed various corruption on console issues after prolonged play
[*] Fixed corrupt-looking start lights when racing
[/list]

[h2]GUI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed players no longer being registered for any Scheduled Event if they choose to play a replay
[*] Game returning to splash screen when accessing EULA after Invite resolved
[*] Added widget to access store in-game to allow acquisition of additional content
[*] Fixed crash when simultaneously pressing “Delete” and “Back” keys on a saved Style before selecting “Yes” to the dialogue box
[*] Added the garage button in Career screens
[*] Players prevented from selling cars while game is generating Thumbnails to avoid a crash and UI disappearing 
[*] Fixed crashes when setting passwords in the lobby screen
[*] Fixed various crashes when saving replays on consoles
[*] PS4: Fixed username to show when not online/signed in
[/list]

[h2]Career[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Jerez Clock Watcher Event difficulty
[/list]

[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] KTM X-Bow R: Adjusted callipers and suspension to avoid clipping with upgrade rims
[*] Ford GTLM: Re-enabled LODA chassis damage
[*] BMW 2002 Racing: made the driver seat wider to avoid clipping with character 
[*] Fixed various broken wheel rim blurs
[*] The boost “200 HP Hybrid Boost” still remaining equipped to the 2016 Ford Fiesta OMSE Supercar Lites in race, even if player has set Boost back to “No Hybrid Boost” within Upgrades resolved
[*] Fixed rain drops not appearing on certain custom liveries
[*] More accurate vehicle windscreen reflections enabled
[/list]

[h2]Wheels[/h2]
[list]
[*] Default wheel deadzones across all platforms now matched. 
[*] Steering deadzone removed from consoles to reduce vagueness around centre
[/list]

[h2]Tracks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Yas Marina 
[*] Nurburgring sponsor updates 
[*] Adjusted various pre-race cams to resolve flickering
[/list]

[h2]VR[/h2]
[list]
[*] Numerous tweaks and fixes
[*] Disabled depth of field in main menu when in VR and triple screen
[*] Fixed the in-game special effect audio that vanishes when waking the Oculus Rift after leaving it to enter standby mode during a race
[*] Fixed user being able to access Photo Mode in the garage in VR mode while using a gamepad
[*] Various Additional Miscellaneous Fixes 
[/list]

notes.title: Project CARS 3 Update 1.4
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Project CARS 3! We hope [url=https://bnent.eu/PC3_NewPatch]this latest update[/url] will improve your playing experience.

[h2]Audio[/h2]
* Fixed double audio when quitting during the 3-2-1 pre-race countdown

[h2]Rendering[/h2]
* Toned down red crash vignette 
* Fixed clouds popping-in during races
* Fixed shiny vinyls when using gloss base
* Fixed random shadow flickering in-game

[h2]GUI[/h2]
* Fixed Player Label corruption upon restarting a race 
* Improvements to Replay Mode UI
* Fixed inability to select anyone below P12 in Spectator Mode 
* Tuning button in Pre-Race Menu now shows the name of currently-selected tuning setup
* Tuning button disabled in Rivals
* Fixed screens not showing "Blizzard" weather type
* Weather info made consistent throughout all screens in-game
* Enabled Photo Mode in replay
* Default colours to be used by patterns (black, white, grey) assigned
* Added on-screen hint for how to take a photo in Photo Mode
* Improved player label visuals for online / offline experience.
* Background now scales with text.
* Fixed fonts on Player labels on restarting a race
* Lap counter on point-to-point tracks hidden
* Subtitles stuck in races fixed


[h2]Career[/h2]
* Increased Difficulty for Road E
* Increased Road D Hot Lap 3 target time
* Increased Road D Pace Setter 2 target time
* Increased Difficulty for GT C & GT B
* Adjusted Race Length for GT C Race 5
* Adjusted Race Length for GT B Race 5
* Adjusted difficulty for Challenges Championships to match other changes
* Adjusted number of corners to master in GT A Majors Long Beach from 10 to 9
* Fixed invalid lap-time during rolling starts at Havana Capitolio
* Fixed issue where the car lost all its customisation and appeared red in the 2nd round of the championships in Career


[h2]Online[/h2]
* Always use player’s choice for gearing when in Quick Play and Scheduled Events assigned
* Player now returns to lobby when quitting out of Spectator Mode
* Rivals event participation rewards increased


[h2]Crash Fixes[/h2]
* Fixed a crash when tuning the Jaguar XJ220 and the McLaren F1
* Fixed crash when user selected replay from a customisation screen on re-entering from a replay
* Fixed crash when last "My Style" was removed
* Fixed customisation rims size crashing if moving between vehicles with different number of available sizes
* Fixed crash when entering "Deal of the Day" via the career


[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
Formula E: 
* GUI logo, vehicle name, and country flag updated 
* DS Techeetah team livery updated
* Championship livery added, set as new default livery


[h2]Peripherals[/h2]
* Logitech wheels issues on PS4 fixed
* Support added for Thrustmaster T-GT


[h2]PC Only[/h2]
* Profanity filter for system messages removed
* Improved performance on high "super sampling" 
* Triplescreen settings UI improvements
* Fixed triplescreen configuration issues on frontend
